_check_f._why: 2026-08-29: three entries added, one per language, for the power-reserve family. Their 70 is hours of reserve and collided with the catalogue reaching 70 records when the Bigotti Two Tone Roman was added. They are waived rather than wrapped because the only marker that would fit is data-stat="n", the retired count token, and no page states how many watches. They delete themselves the next time the catalogue moves. Previously: 2026-08-27: three entries added, one per language, all the same FAQ sentence; each carries its own reason and date. They arrived with the Christmas gift guide committed in a581e1e earlier the same day. An earlier draft of this note blamed the gate for under-scanning, which was WRONG: the blog page count moved from 289 to 304 because seven commits between 11:35 and 13:29 added exactly 15 blog files, five article families in three languages. The gate was right the whole time. The plain-paragraph mentions of the same figure were wrapped in data-stat markers rather than waived. Previously: Empty again as of 2026-08-25. It was empty by design from 2026-08-17, gained three entries that same day, and has now shed them. The three blog indexes were the original permanent entries, held because the featured card rendered a catalogue count from the {n} and {u10k} tokens; those tokens are retired, because no page states how many watches. The three age entries that replaced them existed only because the 92.25 repricing moved u10k to 55, which collided with 'a 25-year-old and a 55-year-old' in one sentence. Adding the Philippe Lauren PL2391-2 moved u10k to 56, the collision vanished, and the ratchet reported all three as having no hit left. That is exactly what each entry's own reason said would happen and what it said to do. Deleted, not renumbered: an allowlist that only ever shrinks is the point. 2026-09-04: 29 entries added when the Daniel Klein Premium Black Dial took {u10k} to 60 and {n} to 72, two numbers already published as a price tier, a birthday age, a price range and a 72-hour power reserve. Same class as the 70-hour family above and self-cleaning the same way. 2026-09-07: all 29 of those deleted, on schedule. Six watches took the catalogue to 66 and 78 and check F reported every one as carrying no live number. Notably the new values collided with NOTHING, so no replacement waivers were needed.
